stem.text: Hydrogen bromide can be added to T to give compound U. Compound U can be hydrolysed to compound V.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme with skeletal structures: T (a methyl-substituted cyclopentene) goes by step 1 to U (a bromo-methylcyclopentane), which goes by step 2 to V (a hydroxy-methylcyclopentane).

stem.text: Four students, W, X, Y and Z, made the following statements.
W All the atoms in a molecule of compound T lie in the same plane.
X Compound V contains only one chiral centre.
Y Step 1 is an electrophilic addition reaction.
Z Step 2 is a nucleophilic substitution reaction.
